cards.title: louis-agent.identity.puls
cards.text: One small class and a folder of embedded prompts: its name, its packs, and the roles it may ask.

cards.title: What Puls says
cards.text: A voice file per language, the same sections in each; the routing in voice.md.

cards.title: Add a language
cards.text: voice-{xx}.md, then puls/voice-{xx} in ROLES_ENABLED; the language menu finds it.

cards.title: Add a specialist or minion
cards.text: Its prompt, a PulsRole and a PulsCall, an eval it passes, then the routing and ROLES_ENABLED.

cards.title: A new capability
cards.text: A pack, named in PulsIdentity.Packs, never a project reference.

cards.title: Test it
cards.text: The identity's tests, and the session golden file whose diff is the review.
